QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: authMethod
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Authentication method used for the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: endpointUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint used by the MAVLink Console AI assistant.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modelName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Model name sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: apiKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Personal bearer token sent to the configured endpoint. Leave empty for local endpoints that do not require authentication.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthDeviceAuthorizationUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth 2.0 device authorization endpoint used to request a user code.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthTokenUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint used to poll for an access token.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthClientId
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth client ID registered with the provider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthScope
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth scopes requested during authorization. Leave empty if the provider does not require scopes.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthAccessToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth access token received from the provider.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthRefreshToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OAuth refresh token received from the provider, if provided.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthTokenExpiresAtUtc
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UTC epoch seconds when the OAuth access token expires.
